authority: Generated concept images are review aids only. Canon and the audited official or archival sources remain authoritative; these images do not approve production models or complete T082.
sharedPromptConstraints: Render one LEGO-like brick-built subject in matte black so recognition depends on geometry rather than faction colour.
Preserve the audited source construction, locomotion/contact pattern, hero mechanism and identity-bearing negative space.
Use a clean white studio background, soft neutral shadow, crisp three-quarter isometric view and a fully visible subject.
Exclude labels, logos, UI, scenery, unrelated models and decorative shapes unsupported by the source-derived contract.
